background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is an approved game menu design. Prepare its BACKGROUND ONLY for a real game. Remove exactly ALL FIVE UI buttons completely, including their frames, lettering, icons, stars embedded in button faces, borders and button shadows: the three large lower-center buttons 开始探索, 继续游戏, 查看历史探索记录; the top-right 设置 button with gear; and bottom-right 图鉴 button with book. Reconstruct the checkered cream/lavender paper stage floor under the three central buttons, curtain fabric behind the top-right button, and foreground purple paper foliage behind the bottom-right button. Maintain all existing scenery and every other star decoration, stage arch, castle, bridge, windmill, hanging ornaments, paper grain, lighting, perspective, palette, exact framing. No characters or elemental balls; none exist in this approved source. No text, lettering, menu controls, placeholder rectangles, icons, or logos anywhere in the result. Same full landscape canvas, seamless background plate, unchanged outside removed UI areas.
atlas:
Use case: ui-mockup, game UI asset extraction/reconstruction. The input is the approved visual reference for paper ticket buttons. Produce a TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND texture atlas with FOUR independent blank button frames, retaining the exact burgundy/cream/purple layered cardstock texture and thin warm-gold inset double rims from that image. No text, no letters, no numerals, no icon, no stars, no glyph, no backdrop, no guide or grid. All empty interiors need clean paper grain for native game text overlay.
Canvas aspect 3:2, ideally 1536x1024. FOUR equally spaced HORIZONTAL ROWS, each one-quarter of the canvas high. Exactly ONE centered frame per row, generous transparent gap.
Row1 centered at y12.5%: long BURGUNDY red ticket, width88% of canvas, height17% of canvas, delicately clipped/stepped corners and ivory outer paper edge, thin warm-gold double rim, subtle drop shadow.
Row2 centered at y37.5%: identical long DEEP PLUM purple ticket, same width and height, cream/gold double rim.
Row3 centered at y62.5%: identical long CREAM PAPER ticket, same width and height, fine gold border and subtle sewn/dashed inset line.
Row4 centered at y87.5%: SMALL COMPACT CREAM PAPER ticket, width22% of canvas and height17% of canvas (about 2:1 width to height), similar clipped corners and gold rim, BLANK interior. This is for corner settings/book buttons; do not add their icons or lettering.
All four buttons are orthographic flat 2D front view, precise horizontal alignment, no perspective tilt, soft short shadows only. Keep each complete frame wholly within its own row. Only these four isolated frames on true alpha transparency. Do not include any scene from the reference.
